crossRefs.note: “But the father said to his servants, ‘Bring out the best robe, and put it on him. Put a ring on his hand, and sandals…
and having fitted your feet with the preparation of the Good News of peace,
Only let your way of life be worthy of the Good News of Christ, that whether I come and see you or am absent, I may…
The princess inside is all glorious. Her clothing is interwoven with gold.
I will be to you a Father. You will be to me sons and daughters,’ says the Lord Almighty.”
As for this image, its head was of fine gold, its breast and its arms of silver, its belly and its thighs of bronze,
but speaking truth in love, we may grow up in all things into him who is the head, Christ,
from whom all the body, being fitted and knit together through that which every joint supplies, according to the…
and not holding firmly to the Head, from whom all the body, being supplied and knit together through the joints and…
“You shall make a breastplate of judgment, the work of the skillful workman; like the work of the ephod you shall make…
He has filled them with wisdom of heart to work all kinds of workmanship, of the engraver, of the skillful workman, and…

translations.web: How beautiful are your feet in sandals, prince’s daughter! Your rounded thighs are like jewels, the work of the hands of a skillful workman.
translations.bsb: How beautiful are your sandaled feet, O daughter of the prince! The curves of your thighs are like jewels, the handiwork of a master.
translations.kjv: How beautiful are thy feet with shoes, O prince's daughter! the joints of thy thighs are like jewels, the work of the hands of a cunning workman.
translations.asv: How beautiful are thy feet in sandals, O prince's daughter! Thy rounded thighs are like jewels, The work of the hands of a skilful workman.
